title: Sanitation before germ theory
h1: Cleanse or die: home and shipboard sanitation before anyone knew about germs
dek: Scrubbed decks, fumigation, army-post pits and the sanitary reform movement, all built on the belief that bad air caused disease. What the scholarship shows worked, what it cannot show, and what the CDC says now.
description: How ships, forts and towns tried to stay healthy under miasma theory, what the records show, and what current CDC guidance says about handwashing and clean water.
recheck: When the Wellcome Collection record for Blane's Observations (rate-limited when we tried) is read, when Chadwick's 1842 report itself is read, or if the CDC revises its handwashing page.

safety_review.scope: Not gated in the taxonomy. Contains a current handwashing statement and a modern verdict panel that a human reviewer should still read before publication.

source_use.hist-home-smith-naval-hygiene: Royal Navy hygiene: washing and fumigating decks, 'cleanse or die', Admiralty instructions, miasma beliefs, contagionist adherents, limits and later decline in casualties.
source_use.hist-home-chadwick-cureus: Miasma theory defined; Chadwick's 1842 report; its cost and rejection; the 1848 Public Health Act; a claimed reduction in cholera and typhoid.
source_use.hist-home-nps-fort-union-water: Privies, pits, bathing and flooding at an army post.
source_use.hist-home-wellcome-snow-map: Archive record of a map from the Cholera Inquiry Committee's 1855 vestry report (Snow's section), which covered sanitation, sewerage, cess pools and water supply.
source_use.hist-home-tulchinsky-snow: Snow's two-water-company comparison and the 14-times figure.
source_use.hist-home-snow-mode-of-communication: Snow's description of the comparison as an experiment on the grandest scale.
source_use.rmg-life-at-sea: Poor storage, ventilation and vermin degraded shipboard food; scurvy and malnutrition.
source_use.hist-home-cdc-clean-hands: Handwashing with soap prevents respiratory and diarrheal infections; five steps; 60% alcohol sanitizer when soap is unavailable.
source_use.cdc-water-safe: Current CDC water-safety guidance as the modern benchmark.
source_use.hist-home-wellcome-chadwick-1842: Archive record of a digitized copy of Chadwick's 1842 report (imprint, parliamentary presentation, 546 images). Catalogue record only.
